title: Design System: GDG on Campus RVCE — Swiss Editorial Grid × Material 3 Expressive

headline.purpose: Route titles and major section headings.

title.purpose: Event cards, list rows, agenda items, and team member names.

body.purpose: Reading columns, event descriptions, and bios.

data.purpose: Tabular schedules, countdowns, venues, and ⌘K shortcuts.

shadows.name: overlay-sheet
shadows.purpose: Transient fixed overlays only (CommandPalette and Member Profile drawer); page surfaces remain flat with 1px hairlines.

motion.name: lazy-motion-spring
motion.purpose: Physics-driven layoutId nav indicators, filter pills, and tactile micro-interactions with minimal initial bundle.

motion.name: theme-view-transition
motion.purpose: Circular radial Light/Dark theme transition originating from the ThemeToggle button center.

motion.name: scroll-progress-hairline
motion.purpose: 2px four-color Google reading progress hairline along Navbar bottom edge.

narrative.overview: GDG on Campus RV College of Engineering pairs a Swiss editorial hairline grid with saturated Material 3 Expressive geometry, original inline SVG domain artwork (DomainArtwork.tsx), and async LazyMotion spring physics. Zero Fake UI: no fabricated Lighthouse scores, fake curl logs, or corporate jargon.
keyCharacteristics: Swiss editorial grids on warm paper (#FAF9F6) and carbon-slate (#0C0F14) toggled via Tailwind CSS v4 @custom-variant dark and View Transitions API.
Standardized motion/react + LazyMotion (async domMax) + motion/react-m (* as m) wrapped in MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'.
Disciplined Google four-color wayfinding with WCAG AA --gdg-blue-ink and strict #111827 dark ink on Google Yellow.
Zero Fake UI: authentic schedules, prerequisites, fuzzy ⌘K navigation, and one-click .ics exports.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Never place white text on Google Yellow (#FBBC04 or #FDD663). Always pair yellow surfaces with #111827 dark ink.

rules.name: The Split-Blue Contrast Rule
rules.body: Reserve #4285F4 for marks, borders, and focus rings; use --gdg-blue-ink (#1765CC Light / #669DF6 Dark) for small interactive blue text.

rules.name: The Zero Fake UI Rule
rules.body: Never display hardcoded Lighthouse scores, fake curl outputs, or corporate jargon like Compact Ledger or Builder Dossier.

rules.name: The LazyMotion Strict Rule
rules.body: Load domMax asynchronously via LazyMotion strict and import * as m from motion/react-m so the initial bundle stays minimal.

dos: Do use motion/react-m inside LazyMotion strict + MotionConfig reducedMotion='user'.
Do pair Google Yellow strictly with #111827 dark ink and use --gdg-blue-ink for small blue text.
Do guard client-dependent UI (ThemeToggle, CountdownTimer) via useSyncExternalStore for zero hydration warnings.
Do preserve p-2 clear space around <GdgLogo />, open-source credits, and the independent student chapter disclaimer.
donts: Don't include fake Lighthouse scores, fake curl outputs, or corporate jargon (Compact Ledger, Builder Dossier).
Don't place white text on Google Yellow anywhere.
Don't import heavy WebGL/Lottie libraries (three, @react-three/fiber, spline, lottie-web), or add analytics, RSVP counters, attendee lists, comments, live chat, real student PII, or forbidden routes.
